positions.title: EACS Computer Consultant
positions.description:
•	Install, update, and maintain software systems and hardware for more than 5 buildings on engineering campus
•	Provide technical support and setup for events on-campus in order to ensure success

company.name: University of Michigan College of Engineering

positions.title: Assistant in Research
positions.description:
•	Utilized Amazon’s Alexa Skills SDK to create custom program on Amazon Echo to dispense information to users
•	Worked with IBM’s Watson platform to implement natural-language processing and generation in automated communication bot
•	Designed and developed 2D and 3D games in Unity Game Engine to assist social anxiety patients 
•	Integrated intuitive user functionality using C# and JavaScript programming languages
•	Implemented Parse as an efficient remote database to track user data and improve data accessibility

positions.title: Junior iOS Developer
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with development team to create and deploy efficient, secure iOS application in Swift using Xcode IDE
•	Utilized Xcode to apply layout for iOS application to ensure compatibility with multiple devices
•	Helped implement secure, reliable backend to store and easily retrieve application data for enhanced performance

positions.title: ConnectIT Intern
positions.description:
• Pioneered mobile development by prototyping first cross-platform mobile UI for associates
• Implemented functionality to nominate associates by utilizing Xamarin IDE in C#
• Assisted with organization and information of EHR software upgrade

positions.title: Math Center Tutor/Transitional Studies Assistant
positions.description:
• Effectively communicated new topics to students and demonstrated proper use of tools, such as TI-83 calculator
• Worked productively with co-workers to promote and ensure a quality learning environment
• Assisted in homework/test preparation by introducing new problem solving methods
• Collaborated with professors to ensure class is properly executed to maximize effectiveness
• Effectively assisted faculty with technical or other issues experienced during class

positions.title: UROP Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Designed 2D and 3D games using Unity Game Engine
• Added user functionality to custom games using C# and JavaScript programming languages
• Implemented Parse as efficient database to track user data
• Gained technical knowledge and experience through 400+ hours of research

positions.title: Summer Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Analyzed, compared and presented data through effective use of graphs
• Created and modified data-analysis programs using C++ language
• Wired and created code for efficient low cost data-gathering objects
• Extensively tested and programmed washing machines using specialized equipment

honors.title: All-USA Academic Team Representative
honors.description: Selected as a nominee to represent Lake Michigan College's Napier Campus in the All-USA Academic Competition.
